question: Should this Feishu media fallback PR require real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client seam proof?
rationale: The code path is narrow and matches the existing text/card fallback contract, but repository policy treats external channel delivery changes as needing real behavior proof unless maintainers intentionally waive that gap.

options.title: Require real Feishu proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted live output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording proves image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal.

options.title: Accept mocked seam proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on source-level helper reuse and tests while owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require real Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted live output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording proves image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the existing Feishu reply fallback helper and merged the adjacent fallback behavior this PR extends.
